_note: This file is a pure Python-style configuration file (dict-based) for MMDetection's Deformable DETR model. It contains no callable functions, classes, or methods — only configuration variables and imports. Per instructions, no fabricated examples are included.
configure_deformable_detr_model: configure a DeformableDETR model with ResNet-50 backbone for COCO object detection using mmengine config dicts
configure_train_pipeline: configure the training data pipeline with RandomChoiceResize, RandomCrop, and RandomFlip augmentations for COCO detection
configure_optimizer: configure an AdamW optimizer with gradient clipping and param-wise learning rate multipliers for backbone and sampling offsets
configure_param_scheduler: configure a MultiStepLR learning rate scheduler with a milestone at epoch 40 for 50-epoch training
configure_hungarian_assigner: configure a HungarianAssigner with FocalLossCost, BBoxL1Cost, and IoUCost for bipartite matching during training
